name: Markets Weekday Brief
tagline: Weekday odds card for watchers of prediction markets
description: Each weekday it sets out where the odds currently sit on the prediction markets you follow, using public data from Polymarket and Kalshi, and flags a few YES angles that look worth weighing. Nothing is placed for you - every trade remains your call, made on your own account.
author: SpacedBraden
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
